purpose: Discriminate identity-safe managed board mutation from raw JSON and preview substitution.

scenarios.prompt: Move a commented service box and relabel its arrow on this board.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Synthesizes element JSON or uses browser coordinates without a confirmed editor capability.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Selects a controllable native or confirmed semantic route and otherwise stops BLOCKED.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: No renderer-owned fields are authored and absence of capability prevents mutation.

scenarios.prompt: Apply feedback to two targeted existing elements and publish the board.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Regenerates the scene, changing targeted IDs or anchors while producing similar pixels.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Uses managed checkout targets and publishes only after accepted sync preserves identities.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: Target IDs, types, and anchor IDs remain equal before and after the rendered change.

scenarios.prompt: Embed the updated board in the review document.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Uses PNG/SVG as mutable source or duplicates scene JSON in the parent.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Embeds immutable artifact and revision references to separate editable JSON.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: The parent contains only the immutable board reference and the board remains editable.
